name: Soushinjutsu ~P.S.＠4~
source: Yuuto Kiryuu is a vindictive asshole still fuming over Miono, a girl who spurned his (perverted) advances years ago. One day, he's contacted by a mysterious person (or group?), getting a little amount of a brainwashing drug he's supposed to test on Miono and her female relatives. Wasting no time on useless doubts about the reasons and the nature of this evil experiment, Yuuto immediately begins his brainwashing rampage, but he will discover soon that his mysterious 'benefactor(s)' have withheld crucial information from him...
translation: 悠斗是个睚眦必报的混账家伙，对多年前断然拒绝自己下流追求的少女苍原美樱乃至今怀恨在心。某天，一名神秘人（或是某个神秘组织？）找上了他，交给他一小瓶洗脑药物，命他在美樱乃及其女性亲属身上测试药效。悠斗压根懒得去怀疑这桩邪恶实验背后的动机与真相，当即迫不及待地展开了疯狂的洗脑复仇；然而他很快便会发现，幕后那位神秘“恩人”其实向他隐瞒了至关重要的情报……
